import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

nz = 11
ds = xr.Dataset(
    data_vars={
        "y": ("z", np.random.rand(nz)),
        "lev": ("z", np.arange(nz) * 10),
    },
)

ds2 = (
    ds.swap_dims(z="lev")
    .rename_dims(lev="z")
    .reset_index("lev")
    .reset_coords()
)

lev_before = ds2.variables["lev"]
print("ds2 lev type:", type(lev_before), "dims:", lev_before.dims)

swapped = ds2.swap_dims(z="lev")
lev_after = ds2.variables["lev"]
print("same variable object?", lev_before is lev_after)
print("ds2 lev dims after swap_dims:", ds2["lev"].dims)
print("swapped lev dims:", swapped["lev"].dims)

# identity trace: which object got mutated
print("\n-- identity trace --")
for k, v in ds2.variables.items():
    print(f"  ds2.variables[{k!r}] id={id(v):#x} type={type(v).__name__} dims={v.dims}")
for k, v in swapped.variables.items():
    print(f"  swapped.variables[{k!r}] id={id(v):#x} type={type(v).__name__} dims={v.dims}")

assert ds2["lev"].dims == ("z",), "BUG: original ds2 was modified by swap_dims"
print("\nOK: original untouched")
